<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 262.099 Da. Assuming this is the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral mass is ≈262.099 Da. The elemental composition that matches this exact mass most closely is C₁₃H₁₄N₂O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass 262.095 Da, within typical instrument error). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C13H14N2O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H14N2O4</final_answer>
